newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha up $3 on earlier crude gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha up $3 on earlier crude gains.

text.p: The European naphtha market made swap gains of around $3 on the front month on Tuesday, largely on the back of crude futures gains of late Monday, as brokers August swap trades at $194 and $194.50.
September swaps were meanwhile traded twice at $191.50, also around $3 up on the day as October backwardation to September narrowed until it was all but eliminated.

The swap gains were reflected by bidding by one London-based trader in particular, who was heard quoting $194 for open spec and $195 for pipeline spec naphtha, compared with end-Monday published quotes in the $191-$193 CIF NWE range..
